item.title: Backpressure is all you need
item.description:
📝 In that case, the test suite is the backpressure mechanism for a human to clean up their code before asking for a review. That way, we could stop reviewing code that wasn't even close to being ready, and we could focus our human attention on the things that machines can't check, like readability, complexity, and overall design. We need tests that fail early, types that push back, be.
🔗 Read more: https://www.lucasfcosta.com/blog/backpressure-is-all-you-need

item.title: United Airlines 767 Returns to Newark After Bluetooth Name Sparks Alert
item.description:
📝 United Airlines Bluetooth Threat Incident Credit: Flightradar24 According to flight tracking data, United Flight 236 from Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) to Palma De Mallorca Airport (PMI) departed Newark at 6:08 PM local time, and was approximately 60 minutes into its transatlantic journey before the security situation escalated. Date May 30, 2026 Airline United Airlines Flight Code UA236 Aircraft Type Boeing 767-400ER (N67052) Departure Airport Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) Destination Airport Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI) Fate Returned to EWR; passengers boarded a replacement flight This was repeated multiple times, with the crew eventually issuing a final one-minute warning. Saturday's incident has parallels with another security scare that occurred on a United flight earlier this month.
🔗 Read more: https://simpleflying.com/united-airlines-767-returns-newark-bluetooth-name-alert/
